Harbor Point Planning Commission — Minutes, October 8, 2026. Commissioners present: Ahn, Byrne, Castillo, Haddad-Reyes, Lindqvist, Mwangi, Pereira, St. Clair. Absent: Ostrowski.

Item 4, Conditional Use Permit CUP-26-031 (Old Cannery Arts Collective). Senior Planner Teodoro summarized the staff report, noting that the applicant, which recently moved into the former cannery office building on Wharf Road, intends to host a nine-day motion picture festival in June with outdoor screenings from 7:30 to 11:00 p.m. Three members of the public spoke, two in support and one raising parking concerns, and the applicant agreed to a shuttle condition. Commissioner Pereira asked whether amplified sound would stop by 10:30, and staff confirmed it would. After further discussion Commissioner St. Clair moved approval of CUP-26-031 subject to the conditions in the staff report plus the shuttle condition, which Commissioner Haddad-Reyes seconded, and the motion passed on a vote of seven in favor, none opposed, with Commissioner Byrne abstaining because of a business relationship with the applicant. The Chair then moved on to Item 5, a study session on the waterfront plan, for which no action was taken.
